findings.detail: Two wrong options repeat earlier question M4-S29-T1, which has the same scene: a teammate claims only one MCP server works at a time and proposes a change, and the answer is to keep both servers. Option B (two separate sessions, passing the findings by hand) repeats that question's 'split into two subagents, pass sources from the first to the second'. Option C (restart with only the issue tracker server after the first step to rediscover its tools) repeats 'disconnect the web search server and connect the citation server so its tools are discovered'. The rule allows at most one repeated wrong option.

blind_answer.reason: Tools from all servers configured in .mcp.json are discovered at connection time and are available to the agent at the same time (2.4-K3). The agent can inspect the schema and file the issue in a single session, so the teammate's workflow change isn't needed.
